new_page.title: Schools in Abbotsford, BC | Full List by Level | Jared Gibbons
new_page.description: Browse 55 public and independent schools with a Abbotsford address, grouped by level with street addresses. From the BC Ministry of Education and Child Care l

blocks.text: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care school list shows 55 schools with a Abbotsford street address: 47 public schools and 8 independent schools. It also shows 5 college and university campuses. In that list, 6 schools marked as offering French Immersion, 1 alternate program and 2 online schools.
Public schools here are run by School District 34 (Abbotsford). Count by district: School District 34 (Abbotsford): 47.
Alternate programs, continuing education centres and online schools that have a street address sit under "other public schools and programs"; the level of every school is read from its name.

Public secondary schools with a Abbotsford address: Abbotsford Senior Secondary School, Bakerview Centre for Learning - CE, Rick Hansen Secondary, Robert Bateman Secondary, W J Mouat Secondary and Yale Secondary.

The Ministry file marks these Abbotsford schools as offering French Immersion: Centennial Park Elementary, Chief Dan George Middle, Clearbrook Elementary, Margaret Stenersen Elementary, Sandy Hill Elementary and W J Mouat Secondary.

Independent schools listed for Abbotsford include Abbotsford Christian School, Cornerstone Christian School, Dasmesh Punjabi School, Mennonite Educational Institute, Pacific Christian School and St. James and St. Ann's Elementary and 2 more.
Before an offer, ask the district which school serves the exact street address.

faq.q: How many schools are in Abbotsford, BC?
faq.a: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care list shows 55 schools with a Abbotsford street address: 47 public schools and 8 independent schools. The count includes alternate programs and online schools that have a street address.
Public schools with a Abbotsford address are run by School District 34 (Abbotsford).

faq.q: How do I find the catchment school for a Abbotsford address?
faq.a: Ask School District 34 (Abbotsford) to confirm it for the exact street address.
